source: webkit-undo-fast-diagnostics and webkit-undo-fast-retry-diagnostics artifacts of every push-to-main Tests run still retained on 2026-09-18 (200 runs listed; artifacts from 2026-09-11 onward survived)

fields.firstPollRoundTripMs: Node-side wall time of the first settle poll: settleHistory's trace[0].atMs, whose clock starts only after the draw evaluate has returned to Node. Catches a stall in front of the first poll, NOT one inside the draw evaluate's own return.
fields.firstPollFrames: The page's rAF stamps between drawEnd (page clock, the end of the synchronous strokes) and the first poll's read: count, firstMs/lastMs relative to drawEnd, and maxGapMs between consecutive stamps. A stall on either side of the evaluate's IPC return shows here as a late firstMs or a large maxGapMs (the 2026-09-06 run whose poll read 42 ms had stamps 55 -> 6,253 ms).
fields.crayonShadowMs: Every engine.crayonShadow measure in the settle trace.
